==Usage==
This template is used to create headings for story arcs in comic tables. Parameter {{Para|tpb}} is used to add collections using {{Tl|Comictable-tpb}}, where applicable.
 <nowiki>{{</nowiki>Comictable-arc|''arc name''|tpb=}}
